summary: Reviewed PR #22 is merged: the console defaults to light mode, supports both themes and adapts from 320px phones through tablets to ultrawide displays. Product 8419cb9 passes 183 Node, 17 queue, 42 simulator and 41 Chromium checks in main CI. Fidelity remains Partial: accepted pending-command/draft-safety design is UNEXECUTED; task transfer and real tool approval remain incomplete. Recovery retains its three-issue final-review hold and exhausted correction limit. Real-provider, real-repository and hosting gates remain separate and incomplete.

items.title: Durable executor communication queue
items.notes: Private SQLite assignments, leases, immutable reports/decisions and restart cursor. PR #16 fixes leading-dash lease arguments in callers/examples; 17 offline protocol tests pass on integrated main, including deterministic dash-token renew/report and separate worker processes.

items.title: Registered executor wakeup acceptance
items.notes: Native Codex claim/report/follow-up cycles and local verification subagent report/follow-up claim are verified. The optional local transport records collaboration identity and omits inherited native thread IDs. Claude cloud cannot access this Mac-local queue; no cloud bridge or sleeping external launcher is provided.

items.notes: Provider access confirmed Sep 8 with one authorized gpt-5.6-sol request at $0.113582. Further runs require explicit budgets and the intended runner environment; the single-call allowance does not authorize them.
